definitions.action_tensor: drag/480, true 1000 ms hold, tap/1000, 1; #62 bounds check not applied
definitions.aggregate_error: unmasked mean squared error of all 236 carrier values, as #74

bootstrap.note: seed differences averaged before resampling; descriptive development only

definitions.candidates: coverage-admissible fixed actions only; dropped candidates reported, never worst-cased
definitions.claims: normal-mechanics breadth only; no zero-shot/few-shot novelty claim (stage N2)
definitions.endpoint_semantics: observed-frame units (1 frame = 50 native steps); t=600 is end-of-window, right-censored branches included, NOT a settled cost
definitions.field_masks: target availability only; presence[0]/mask1, kind[2,11]/mask4, position[5,6]/mask7, motion[8,9]/mask10
definitions.local: observed context at t-h -> t, evaluation only; shared initial carrier when t-h=0
definitions.membership: held_out_evaluation lineages with >=1 coverage-admissible branch, sorted by identity
definitions.prior: candidate index 8 (ordinal09), no-model baseline; uniform-random expected regret retained
definitions.recursive: one shared initial carrier; predictions feed next transition; no truth resets
definitions.task: predicted count cost at t=600 versus actual end-of-window count cost; not a local MSE
definitions.terminal_absorption: offsets beyond an early-terminal branch's last frame reuse the terminal frame's carrier (stable-terminal absorption); absorbed offsets recorded
definitions.typed_failure_absorption: failed branches excluded from candidates; reported in coverage summary

limitations: shared semantically supervised CNN, not end-to-end symbol-free comparison
t=600 is end-of-window cost on mostly right-censored branches, not settled cost
at most four independent held-out states; bootstrap intervals are descriptive
typed branch failures excluded from candidates and reported, never worst-cased
linear MACs not full FLOPs or matched total work
